name: web-content-organizer-flat-illustration-phone-calendar-sticky-notes
title: Flat illustration of a man organizing content with a giant phone media player and a calendar full of sticky notes
whatItIs: A white-background flat illustration of a man placing a photo card into folders, beside a giant phone showing a video player and list rows, and a large calendar grid covered in colourful sticky-note reminders with ticks and crosses.
whatItMeans: Friendly and clear; the giant phone and calendar make abstract 'content planning' feel like a tangible, physical task.
techniques: Scale key tools (phone, calendar) larger than the human figure.
Cover a calendar with varied sticky-note shapes for texture.
Use a simple flat palette against white for universal appeal.

vocabulary.definition: Small varied note shapes used to fill a surface with detail.
Enlarging key objects relative to a figure to highlight their importance.
